item.title: Review Tooltips for Hover, Focus and Dismissal
item.description: Test whether temporary help can be reached, read and dismissed without losing context. Distinguish a brief tooltip from interactive content that needs another pattern.

item.title: Find Keyboard Focus Hidden Behind Sticky Headers
item.description: Test focus beneath sticky headers, footers and banners. Fix overlapping page chrome and verify forward and backward navigation at enlarged sizes.

item.title: Test a Page with User Text-Spacing Overrides
item.description: Review text after line, paragraph, letter and word spacing increase together. Find clipping and lost controls without redesigning the site around one preset.

item.title: Review Reflow at High Browser Zoom
item.description: Check whether content remains readable and operable at a narrow equivalent viewport. Test page zoom, two-dimensional exceptions and sticky interfaces deliberately.

item.title: Test Missing Resources with Chrome Request Conditions
item.description: Block one image, font or request to review a page’s fallback behavior. Keep patterns narrow, verify the blocked request and restore normal loading afterward.

item.title: Set the Page Language and Mark Language Changes in HTML
item.description: Use a valid lang value for the document and meaningful language changes. Keep language separate from direction, translation and font selection.

item.title: Use Small Caps Without Confusing Them with Uppercase
item.description: Inspect real small-cap glyphs, font support and synthesis before styling a text role. Compare small-caps with uppercase transformation at the sizes you ship.

item.title: Number Section Headings with CSS Counters
item.description: Scope a CSS counter to one article and increment it deliberately. Test nested components and hidden headings, and keep essential numbering in semantic content.

item.title: Write a Design Bug Report a Developer Can Reproduce
item.description: Turn a visual mismatch into a useful report with a trigger, environment and expected behavior. Separate observed evidence from a proposed CSS fix.

item.title: Connect Controls Outside a Form with the form Attribute
item.description: Associate detached inputs and submit buttons with the correct HTML form. Check ownership, field names and submission before rearranging a form layout.

item.title: Why Unchecked Checkboxes Are Missing from FormData
item.description: Inspect checkbox submissions without losing repeated values. Understand unchecked fields, explicit values and the data contract your server must enforce.

item.title: Reset a Form to Its Defaults, Not Necessarily to Empty
item.description: Debug form reset behavior by comparing current and default values. Keep error messages and application state consistent when restoring a form’s defaults.

item.title: Show Partial Selection with an Indeterminate Checkbox
item.description: Build a native select-all checkbox that reflects none, some or all choices. Derive the mixed state from the items and keep submission behavior separate.

item.title: Use datalist for Suggestions, Not a Restricted Choice List
item.description: Choose between datalist and select by whether custom input is allowed. Connect native suggestions to a labeled field and review accessibility fallbacks.

item.title: Validate Multiple Email Entries Without Claiming Delivery
item.description: Use native email fields for one address or a comma-separated list. Distinguish syntax validation from mailbox verification and explain the expected format.

item.title: Why a Flex Item Ignores Its Declared Width
item.description: Trace a flex item’s starting size through flex-basis, width, growth and shrinkage. Use a controlled layout to distinguish a basis from the final width.

item.title: Align Flex Items Within Lines and Lines Within a Container
item.description: Distinguish align-items from align-content in a wrapped flex layout. Create spare cross-axis space and inspect line boundaries before changing alignment.

item.title: Keep Padding and Backgrounds on Wrapped Inline Labels
item.description: Compare slice and clone for a highlighted phrase that wraps across lines. Review box-decoration-break fallbacks, line spacing and real text selection.

item.title: Use an Outline Without Changing the Element’s Layout Size
item.description: Compare outlines and borders when a focus or selection treatment shifts nearby content. Inspect clipping and contrast without hiding the focus indicator.

item.title: Stabilize Table Columns with table-layout: fixed
item.description: Use fixed table layout with an explicit table width and intentional column sizes. Test long cell content without hiding values or losing table semantics.

item.title: Count the Right Siblings with nth-child and nth-of-type
item.description: Debug structural selectors in mixed HTML. Compare sibling position, element type and filtered nth-child queries before using positional component styles.

item.title: Contain a Floated Image with display: flow-root
item.description: Keep a floated illustration inside its section without using overflow as a layout fix. Compare float containment, clipping and deliberate text wrapping.

item.title: Continue or Reverse an Ordered List with Native HTML
item.description: Set ordered-list numbering with start, reversed and item values. Keep the document’s reading order meaningful instead of using CSS to fake a sequence.

item.title: Use Superscripts and Subscripts for Meaningful Notation
item.description: Mark up exponents and chemical subscripts with HTML while keeping line spacing readable. Avoid using semantic notation elements for decorative badges.

item.title: Choose Whether a Background Follows the Box or Its Content
item.description: Compare local, scroll and fixed background attachment inside a scrolling panel. Test panel and page movement separately before copying a visual effect.

item.title: Compare Optical Sizing with the Actual Font File
item.description: Review font-optical-sizing at reading and display sizes. Verify the font’s opsz support and isolate axis overrides before attributing a mismatch to CSS.

item.title: Inspect Ligatures Without Changing the Underlying Text
item.description: Diagnose joined glyphs with font-variant-ligatures and a controlled specimen. Keep characters intact while checking font features, fallback and readability.

item.title: Indent a Paragraph’s First Line Without Padding Every Line
item.description: Use text-indent for a first-line paragraph treatment. Compare it with padding, inspect inheritance and test narrow widths before applying an editorial style.

item.title: Use CSS Columns for Flowing Text, Not Card Row Layout
item.description: Create readable multi-column text with a preferred column width and gap. Inspect the reading path, fragmentation and narrow-screen fallback before shipping.

item.title: Set Component Styling Boundaries with CSS @scope
item.description: Use CSS scope roots and limits to target a component subtree. Inspect inherited values, fallback styles and competing rules before relying on isolation.

item.title: Read Native CSS Nesting Without Miscounting Specificity
item.description: Use the nesting selector to distinguish component states from descendants. Check selector-list specificity and browser-parsed CSS when refactoring styles.

item.title: Submit a Form from JavaScript Without Skipping Validation
item.description: Compare requestSubmit with submit when JavaScript starts a form action. Preserve native validation, submit events and the intended submit button’s behavior.

item.title: Identify Which Button Submitted a Multi-Action Form
item.description: Use SubmitEvent.submitter for forms with multiple actions. Preserve button name and value data, handle missing submitters and test Enter-key submission.

item.title: Fix a Number Field That Rejects an In-Range Decimal
item.description: Debug stepMismatch separately from minimum and maximum errors. Choose a numeric step and base that match the permitted increments, then explain them clearly.

item.title: Write HTML Patterns That Match the Whole Field Value
item.description: Use pattern for an explicit input format, with visible guidance and separate required handling. Test full-value matching, invalid patterns and server validation.

item.title: Label Password Fields with the Correct Autocomplete Purpose
item.description: Use current-password and new-password for their intended tasks. Keep labels, paste and password-manager behavior usable across sign-in and password changes.

item.title: Apply Required Rules Correctly to Radios and Checkboxes
item.description: Distinguish one required radio choice from individually required checkboxes. Test group validity and visible instructions before adding a minimum-selection rule.

item.title: Inspect an Image’s Selected Source and Natural Size
item.description: Read currentSrc and naturalWidth alongside the rendered image box. Distinguish responsive source selection, loading success and density-corrected dimensions.

item.title: Fit a Decorative Background Without Accidental Tiling
item.description: Compare cover and contain for CSS backgrounds, including positioning and repeat. Keep essential imagery in semantic markup and test different box shapes.

item.title: Lay Out Vertical Text with writing-mode and text-orientation
item.description: Use writing-mode for vertical text flow and text-orientation for glyph direction. Review logical sizing, language and reading order before rotating labels.

item.title: Change Text Case Without Rewriting the Content
item.description: Inspect text-transform with language-aware casing and realistic labels. Distinguish uppercase styling from editorial title case, stored data and accessible names.

item.title: Match Native Controls to a Theme with color-scheme
item.description: Use color-scheme to declare supported native UI appearances. Keep custom tokens, selected theme and browser-managed controls consistent across light and dark.

item.title: Measure the Clickable Target, Not Just the Icon
item.description: Review pointer target dimensions and spacing using WCAG 2.2 guidance. Inspect the real hit area, neighboring controls and exceptions in the interface context.

item.title: Choose tabindex Zero or Minus One for the Intended Focus Path
item.description: Distinguish sequential keyboard focus from programmatic focus. Use native controls first and avoid positive tabindex values that create a separate ordering system.

item.title: Move Keyboard Focus Without an Unexpected Scroll Jump
item.description: Use focus with preventScroll when the destination is already visible. Verify activeElement, focus visibility and nested scrolling instead of suppressing movement blindly.

item.title: Reveal an Element with Deliberate Scroll Alignment
item.description: Choose start, center or nearest alignment for scrollIntoView. Review nested scroll containers, sticky headers and motion without confusing scrolling with focus.

item.title: Observe Component Size Changes with ResizeObserver
item.description: Measure a component when its own layout changes, not only when the window resizes. Choose a box, clean up observers and avoid resize feedback loops.

item.title: Choose the Reference Box for an SVG Transform
item.description: Compare fill-box and view-box when an SVG shape rotates around the wrong center. Inspect transparent coordinate space, stroke width and transform origin together.

item.title: Add a Gradient Border with an Explicit Fallback
item.description: Use border-image with a gradient source and slice value. Keep a normal border fallback and check rounded corners, dimensions and forced-colors behavior.

item.title: Put Vendor CSS in a Layer Before Writing Overrides
item.description: Control vendor styles with explicit cascade layers. Check unlayered rules and reversed important precedence before trying to win with stronger selectors.

item.title: Size the Extra Rows Created by CSS Grid
item.description: Use grid-auto-rows for tracks created beyond the explicit grid. Test added items, long content and placement rules without forcing every row to a fixed height.

item.title: Check Whether Stale CSS Comes from the Browser Cache
item.description: Compare cached and uncached loads in Chrome without clearing unrelated site data. Inspect actual response content and service-worker involvement before changing CSS.

item.title: Trace the Request That Loaded an Unexpected Asset
item.description: Use Chrome’s Initiator information to find why an image, font or stylesheet loaded. Separate dependency evidence from assumptions about performance or ownership.

item.title: Pause the Script That Changes an Element’s Class
item.description: Use a DOM attribute breakpoint to catch an unexpected class or inline-style change. Reproduce the smallest interaction and inspect the call stack that caused it.

item.title: Find a Design Token Across Loaded Resources in Chrome
item.description: Search loaded resources for a custom property or class, then verify the winning declaration. Distinguish browser evidence from a complete repository search.

item.title: Start a CSS Animation Partway Through Its Timeline
item.description: Use a negative animation delay to inspect an offset phase. Distinguish elapsed progress from faster playback and check iteration, fill and reduced-motion behavior.

item.title: Use steps() for Discrete Animation States
item.description: Compare step timing with linear interpolation and inspect jump boundaries. Keep decorative steps separate from real progress and provide a static motion alternative.

item.title: Keep an SVG Stroke from Thickening When the Shape Scales
item.description: Use non-scaling-stroke for SVG line work that needs a stable stroke treatment. Compare scaled geometry, clipping and small-size legibility before applying it broadly.

item.title: Fit an SVG ViewBox with meet, slice or none
item.description: Compare SVG aspect-ratio alignment when the viewport shape differs from the viewBox. Check empty space, cropping and distortion as separate design decisions.

item.title: Keep an Unavailable Action Discoverable with aria-disabled
item.description: Use aria-disabled when an unavailable action should remain in the focus path. Guard activation explicitly and explain the reason without relying on dimming alone.

item.title: Keep a Sortable Table’s Order and aria-sort in Sync
item.description: Put sort state on the active table header and sorting behavior on a native button. Reorder complete rows and verify the announced direction matches the data.

item.title: Build a Breadcrumb Trail That Explains Page Location
item.description: Use a labeled navigation region and ordered links for page ancestry. Mark the current page, keep separators decorative and let long breadcrumb labels wrap.

item.title: Investigate Scroll Jumps Before Disabling Anchoring
item.description: Use overflow-anchor as a targeted diagnostic for scroll adjustments. Separate browser anchoring from layout shifts and script-driven scrolling before choosing a fix.

item.title: Scale Pixel Art Without Treating Every Image as Pixelated
item.description: Use image-rendering for intentional pixel graphics and compare integer scaling. Keep photographs, logos and text screenshots on an appropriate rendering path.

item.title: Make a Single-Line Ellipsis Work Without Losing the Full Value
item.description: Combine text-overflow with an actual width constraint and overflow policy. Check flex minimum sizes and provide a reliable way to read the complete value.

item.title: Calculate Background Position from the Remaining Space
item.description: Understand percentage background positioning with a worked width example. Recalculate after cover scaling and distinguish alignment from a fixed pixel offset.

item.title: Choose a Font Display Policy from the Loading Experience
item.description: Compare swap, fallback and optional in a controlled font-loading review. Test readable fallback text and layout changes without promising exact timing across browsers.

item.title: Use a Description List for Named Metadata Values
item.description: Represent label-and-value metadata with dl, dt and dd before styling it as a grid. Preserve grouping, wrapping and reading order across narrow layouts.

item.title: Give an Illustration Context with figure and figcaption
item.description: Group an illustration with a meaningful caption while keeping image alternatives useful. Explain the takeaway in readable text without duplicating every sentence.

item.title: Read Resolved CSS Without Mistaking It for Inline Styles
item.description: Compare element.style with getComputedStyle, capture stable inspection values, and trace the authored rule separately when documenting a website component.

item.title: Keep Scripted Behavior in Sync with a Media Query
item.description: Read a media query at startup, listen for match changes, and remove listeners when a component is destroyed so scripted behavior stays synchronized.

item.title: Set a Touch Gesture Boundary Without Disabling Page Zoom
item.description: Use touch-action deliberately for a custom drag surface, preserve browser panning and pinch zoom, and check cancellation on a real touch device.

item.title: Review Scrollbar Width as a Usability Choice
item.description: Compare native and thin scrollbars in a bounded panel, retain keyboard access, and distinguish scrollbar appearance from the space reserved for it.

item.title: Choose Gaps or Resizing for Repeated Background Tiles
item.description: Compare background-repeat space and round using a fixed-size tile, then inspect narrow widths where tile count and spacing change.

item.title: Why a 50 Percent Border Radius Makes an Ellipse
item.description: Compare percentage radii with large fixed radii on rectangular badges, and preserve a true circle by controlling the rendered box dimensions.

item.title: Trace Alternating Animations One Iteration at a Time
item.description: Distinguish normal, reverse, alternate and alternate-reverse playback, then check iteration boundaries and the final state of a finite animation.

item.title: Give Hover Entry and Exit Different Transition Delays
item.description: Place transition delays in the destination state, compare quick entry and exit, and avoid delaying the feedback that tells a user an action worked.

item.title: Account for SVG Line Caps When Aligning Icons
item.description: Compare butt, round and square caps on identical SVG paths, then check how stroke width changes the visible endpoint and spacing around an icon.

item.title: Restore Holes in a Compound SVG Path with the Right Fill Rule
item.description: Inspect compound paths with nonzero and evenodd, verify contour direction, and avoid painting a fake background-colored hole into a reusable icon.

item.title: Show a Calculated Result with HTML output
item.description: Associate a calculated result with its inputs, handle empty numeric values, and keep displayed output separate from data submitted by the form.

item.title: Route Submit Buttons with Native Form Overrides
item.description: Use formaction and formmethod for distinct native submission destinations, then verify validation, keyboard submission and any JavaScript interception.

item.title: Choose Spellchecking by the Kind of Text Being Edited
item.description: Keep spelling assistance for prose while disabling it for code-like identifiers, and verify the actual browser behavior without treating it as validation.

item.title: Match the Mobile Enter Key Label to the Field’s Action
item.description: Use enterkeyhint to request a useful virtual-keyboard action label, while keeping submission behavior and visible controls implemented separately.

item.title: Read Every Selected Value from a Multiple Select
item.description: Use FormData.getAll for repeated field names, inspect empty selections, and keep the native multiple-select interaction understandable on different devices.

item.title: Align Wrapped List Items with Their Markers
item.description: Compare inside and outside list markers, preserve indentation at narrow widths, and diagnose an unexpected line break before a list item’s paragraph.

item.title: Mark Up Inline Quotations Without Doubling the Quotes
item.description: Use q for a genuine inline quotation, keep source attribution visible, and inspect generated quotation marks before adding punctuation by hand.

item.title: Use placeholder-shown Without Treating It as Validation
item.description: Style a field while its placeholder is visible, distinguish the pseudo-class from placeholder text styling, and test empty, invalid and autofilled states.

item.title: Diagnose Gaps in Text Underlines Before Replacing Them
item.description: Check text-decoration-skip-ink when underlines break around letter descenders, compare the actual font, and keep links recognizable across wrapped lines.

item.title: Choose a Condensed Font Face Instead of Squashing Text
item.description: Inspect font width support and available faces, distinguish font selection from transform scaling, and verify layout with the actual loaded font.

item.title: Blur Behind a Panel Without Blurring Its Text
item.description: Separate filter from backdrop-filter, keep a readable solid fallback, and inspect the surfaces behind a translucent panel before approving its contrast.

item.title: Blend Background Layers Without Blending the Text
item.description: Inspect background-blend-mode with explicit layer ordering, compare a controlled gradient specimen, and keep content colors independent of decorative blending.

item.title: Inspect Individual Transforms Alongside the Transform List
item.description: Check translate, rotate and scale independently from transform, and avoid leaving a second transform active when migrating a component’s movement rules.

item.title: Control a Paragraph’s Last Line Without Adding Spaces
item.description: Use text-align-last for intentional paragraph endings, understand forced line breaks, and avoid manual spacing that fails when text or viewport width changes.

item.title: Control Tab Stops in Displayed Code Without Rewriting It
item.description: Use tab-size with preserved whitespace, distinguish tabs from spaces, and compare copied source with the visual indentation in a code specimen.

item.title: Explain Abbreviations Without Depending on a Hover Tooltip
item.description: Use abbr for abbreviation semantics, provide unfamiliar expansions in visible text, and keep explanations available on touch and keyboard devices.

item.title: Highlight Search Matches with Meaningful HTML mark
item.description: Use mark for query-relevant text, retain readable highlighted colors, and keep result context available when assistive technology does not announce the marking.

item.title: Show Inserted and Deleted Copy in a Design Review
item.description: Use ins and del for edits, provide a plain-language change summary, and distinguish revision markup from text that is simply no longer relevant.

item.title: Give an Informative Inline SVG a Reliable Name
item.description: Name an informative inline SVG with title and aria-labelledby, avoid duplicate IDs in repeated components, and treat decorative icons differently.

item.title: Make New-Tab Links Predictable for Readers
item.description: Use new tabs only when needed, disclose the behavior in the link text, and keep opener behavior separate from the visible navigation experience.

item.title: Select Elements Whose IDs Contain CSS Punctuation
item.description: Escape dynamic CSS identifiers before constructing selectors, compare querySelector with getElementById, and keep selector escaping distinct from HTML handling.

item.title: Refresh DOM Queries When New Components Are Added
item.description: Understand querySelectorAll as a static membership list, requery after DOM changes, and avoid confusing live element references with a live collection.

item.title: Observe Component Attribute Changes Without Watching the Whole Page
item.description: Scope MutationObserver to relevant attributes, capture old values deliberately, and distinguish asynchronous mutation records from a debugger’s call stack.

item.title: Choose Input or Change Events for a Live Preview
item.description: Update text previews during editing with input, distinguish committed changes, and explicitly synchronize the preview after programmatic value assignments.

item.title: Handle Nested Button Clicks with Scoped Event Delegation
item.description: Use closest to resolve clicks on button icons or labels, constrain the action to its component, and preserve native keyboard activation.

item.title: Fix Radio Choices That Deselect Another Component
item.description: Inspect radio names and form ownership when selecting one option clears an unrelated choice, and keep semantic fieldsets separate from grouping behavior.

item.title: Disable a Settings Group While Keeping Its Enable Control Usable
item.description: Use a disabled fieldset with an enable control in its first legend, inspect effective disabled state, and account for omitted form values.

item.title: Let a Draft Action Skip Browser Validation Deliberately
item.description: Use formnovalidate on one submit button while keeping required checks for the final action, and preserve distinct server-side rules for drafts and completion.

item.title: Understand What Dense Grid Packing Does to Visual Order
item.description: Compare sparse and dense auto-placement with mixed item spans, identify backfilled holes, and check keyboard order before using dense packing for controls.

item.title: Separate Flex Gaps from Margins in a Wrapping Tag Row
item.description: Use gap for spacing between flex items, padding for outer space, and inspect margins or distributed alignment when visible gaps exceed the declared value.

item.title: Find the Missing Reference Behind a Percentage Height
item.description: Trace the containing block behind height percentages, compare an explicit parent height with content-driven sizing, and avoid clipping text to force a fit.

item.title: Shrink a Grid Track Without Hiding Its Overflowing Content
item.description: Compare 1fr with minmax(0, 1fr), separate track sizing from content overflow, and choose wrapping or local scrolling for the item inside the track.

item.title: Align One Flex Item Without Changing the Whole Row
item.description: Use align-self for a single cross-axis exception, inspect auto margins and explicit sizes, and recheck the axis when flex-direction changes.

item.title: Audit Shorthand Resets Before Increasing CSS Specificity
item.description: Inspect the longhands written by a shorthand, identify omitted values that reset earlier styling, and make component variants change only their intended properties.

item.title: Group Native Disclosures So Only One Opens at a Time
item.description: Use the details name attribute for exclusive disclosure groups, keep group names scoped to the intended set, and test whether exclusivity helps readers compare content.

item.title: Review Autofocus Before Moving a Reader Past Page Context
item.description: Check when autofocus is appropriate, compare page entry with a deliberately opened dialog, and verify keyboard, scrolling and mobile-keyboard behavior.

item.title: Remove an Underline at Its Source Instead of Fighting a Child
item.description: Trace text-decoration drawn by an ancestor, understand why a child’s none declaration cannot erase it, and preserve a clear link affordance when changing markup.

item.title: Distinguish Zero from Letter O with a Supported Font Feature
item.description: Use slashed-zero for identifiers when the font supports it, compare real glyphs and fallback behavior, and preserve the original characters when copying.

item.title: Review Text Shadows at the Actual Reading Size
item.description: Separate glyph shadows from box shadows, inspect offsets and blur one value at a time, and avoid relying on a glow to make a variable background readable.

item.title: Keep Gradient Text Readable When Its Effect Is Unavailable
item.description: Apply background-clip text as an enhancement, retain a solid color path, and check forced colors, printing and contrast across the full gradient.

item.title: Pair a Conic Gradient Chart with Its Actual Values
item.description: Use conic-gradient for an illustrative proportion graphic, calculate stops from the data, and keep labels and values available outside the CSS background.

item.title: Read Data Attributes as Strings When Inspecting State
item.description: Parse data attribute values explicitly, understand dash-to-camelCase names, and avoid treating the string false as a Boolean false in component logic.

item.title: Let Unknown User Text Choose Its Base Direction
item.description: Use dir auto for text whose direction is not known in advance, inspect punctuation and leading characters, and keep language identification separate from direction.

item.title: Choose Plain-Text Editing Deliberately with contenteditable
item.description: Use plaintext-only for a custom editable surface, keep its accessible name and focus visible, and account for submission and paste behavior beyond the attribute.

item.title: Wait for Font Loading Before Measuring a Text Specimen
item.description: Use document.fonts.ready before a controlled measurement, verify the actual rendered face, and avoid treating one resolved promise as permanent page stability.

item.title: Decode a Replacement Image Before Swapping the Preview
item.description: Keep the previous preview while a new image decodes, handle failed requests, and guard against an older selection replacing a newer one.

item.title: Base a Scripted Animation on Elapsed Time, Not Frame Count
item.description: Use the requestAnimationFrame timestamp for consistent duration, stop the loop at completion, and provide a reduced-motion path and cleanup function.

item.title: Interpret Intersection Ratios Without Calling Them Visibility Proof
item.description: Use IntersectionObserver thresholds for geometric intersection checks, inspect the chosen root, and distinguish partial overlap from actual readable visibility.

item.title: List a Component’s Animations Before Pausing Them
item.description: Inspect getAnimations with a deliberate subtree scope, identify current play states and timing, and avoid assuming the returned list covers every moving image or script.

item.title: Reserve Scroll-Target Clearance on the Scrolling Container
item.description: Use scroll-padding-top for a shared scrollport inset, distinguish it from target scroll margins and ordinary padding, and check sticky toolbars at different sizes.
